mechanisms.description: In Effects of Intensive Glucose Lowering in Type 2 Diabetes (ACCORD Glycemia), baseline hba1c may modify treatment response through differential baseline cardiovascular risk.
Patients with different hba1c levels may show heterogeneous benefit due to variation in baseline disease burden.
Differences in hba1c may alter event risk trajectories, changing absolute treatment benefit.
The association between hba1c and outcome may interact with treatment intensity in the trial population.
Variation in hba1c may identify subgroups with different competing-risk profiles under treatment.

caveats: Generated without external retrieval; grounded only in the trial paper context.
